about.title: Made by hand, from the heart
about.p1: Dream Kitchen began in a tiny home kitchen in Karnataka. Hema was still a student when she spent her savings — just ₹2,500 — on cocoa, moulds and a few gift boxes.
about.p2: Her first boxes went to friends, and soon Instagram found her too. Today Dream Kitchen has grown to a ₹50,000 business, and every single piece is still made by Hema's hands.
about.p3: We use pure ingredients: real cocoa butter chocolate, fresh butter and good nuts. No compound chocolate, no shortcuts. Just the kind of treats we'd give our own family.

v1.text: Real chocolate and honest ingredients — nothing we wouldn't eat ourselves.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add treats to your cart, fill in your delivery details and tap "Place order on WhatsApp". WhatsApp opens with your full order ready — just press send. Hema will reply to confirm.
We don't take payments on the website. After Hema confirms your order on WhatsApp, she will share UPI details. Your order is prepared once payment is received.

items.q: Where do you deliver and how much does it cost?
items.a: We deliver all over Karnataka for a flat ₹{charge}. Pincodes starting with 56, 57, 58 or 59 are accepted.
Small orders can be delivered from the next day. For more than {threshold} pieces in total, please choose a delivery date at least {days} days ahead so everything is made fresh.
Yes! Look for the "Eggless" tag. Our chocolates and truffles are eggless, and we have eggless brownies too.

items.q: How long do the treats stay fresh?
items.a: Our treats have a shelf life of {shelfLife}. Store them in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. In hot weather, keep brownies in the fridge and bring them to room temperature before eating.

items.q: Can I add a message or customise a box?
items.a: Of course. Use the note field at checkout for a gift-box message, or pick our Build-Your-Own Box. For bigger custom orders, send an enquiry.
Yes. Our FSSAI licence number is {fssai}.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my order?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp as soon as possible. Since everything is made fresh, changes are possible until preparation starts.
